summary: Lolo NF lookout in Missoula County: a 30-foot pole L-4 tower listed for 1934, abandoned in 1947 and gone; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing. The state list repeats only the status and coordinates, so the 1934 and 1947 dates rest on the firelookout.com record alone. Two WebSearch queries found no newspaper or agency account. Access is left unset because no source describes it. Next step, if wanted: Missoula newspapers or Lolo NF records.
